meta.target_screen: Fileman 主文件管理窗口及其共享 Finder 风格层

evidence: repair-audit.json: MISMATCH-01..06 cover root structure, pane toolbar placement, sidebar organization, tokens, icons, and state styling.
src/App.vue owns the root window structure and application-level toolbar actions.
src/components/FilePane.vue owns navigation, search, view-mode, and file actions that a Finder toolbar must visually and structurally coordinate.
src/components/AppSidebar.vue owns device, location, favorite, and preview navigation data bindings.
src/style.css provides shared tokens and component classes used throughout the application.
A reusable Finder icon/resource layer and style contract would be consumed by multiple existing components and dialogs.

decision.rationale: The requested reusable Finder design spans root chrome, the file-pane interaction surface, sidebar navigation, shared styles, icon resources, and the wider application. Coordinating those existing responsibilities changes shared UI contracts and navigation presentation, so direct screen-local styling would be unsafe.
